READ-ONLY AUDIT. Do not edit, create, commit or delete any file in treams-rs; do not run builds or tests. Read code and docs only (grep/sed/cat/python3 -c with ast are fine).

Repository: treams-rs (branch claude/r4-python at the integration head). It is treams-rs: a Rust core with a Python package python/treams_rs that mirrors the numerical conventions of the upstream treams package.

Binding references (read these first):

  • plan.md §4 "Glossary" (the table: one name per concept across Rust, bindings, Python, docs) and §5 "Naming rules" (Rust, Bindings, Python sub-rules). Use grep -n '^## ' plan.md to locate them.
  • decisions.md (owner decisions 1 and 6: upstream-mirroring namespaces special, sw, cw, pw, lattice, coeffs, ebcm, misc, io keep upstream function and argument names; physics objects use canonical physics names, with treams-named members as one-line delegations grouped at the end of each class).

YOUR SLICE: names and keywords in python/treams_rs/**/*.py and python/treams_rs/_native.pyi that still disagree with the §4 glossary or §5 rules. Examples of what to look for (verify each against the code, do not assume):

  • 'origins' / 'origin' where the glossary says positions (expansion centres); 'outgoing' where it says singular; 'order' used for l; 'polarization' used for the pol index/state (polarization must mean the convention); 'kind' used for anything other than radial/port kind (e.g. selectors); 'transmission' vs direction; 'a'/'r' naming in non-mirror APIs; 'interface'/'propagation' old diff names; 'cluster' vs sphere_cluster; record/context naming (<DiffName>Context), pullback parameter names, 'VJP' wording.
  • Remember: upstream-mirroring namespaces (special, sw, cw, pw, lattice, coeffs, ebcm, misc, io) legitimately keep treams names and keywords — do NOT report those. Native names (_native.*) that later Rust packages R50a-c/R51 will rename should be listed once in a short summary, not one by one.

For each finding give: file:line, the current name, the glossary/rule it violates (quote the row/rule briefly), the suggested name, and OWNER = the remaining work package that owns the file, using this map (first match wins):

  • python/treams_rs/{special,coeffs,misc,sw,cw,pw}.py -> P25
  • python/treams_rs/lattice.py -> P27
  • python/treams_rs/{ebcm,io,iterative,operators,_operators,_operator_objects,_array,_bases,_lattice,_material,_validation,_polarization,_modes}.py -> P28
  • python/treams_rs/{_tmatrix,_smatrix,_waves,_cluster,_periodic,_results,_upstream,init,diff}.py -> P30
  • python/treams_rs/{advect,jax,torch,testing,_records}.py, python/treams_rs/_framework*.py, python/treams_rs/_native.pyi -> P32
  • tests/api/test_namespaces.py -> P34
  • docs/coming-from-treams/**, docs/reference/glossary.md -> D10
  • README.md, docs/index.md, docs/getting-started/, docs/guide/ -> D08
  • docs/differentiation/** -> D09
  • comment/docstring history wording or doc-path references anywhere in python/tests/scripts/crates -> D18
  • otherwise -> none (say which file) Note: P25-P32 are docstring packages; a keyword/name rename in their files is still routed to them, but mark it "rename (public)" or "rename (private)" so the lead can judge scope.

Return a concise Markdown section: "## Names and keywords against the glossary" with a table | File:line | Current | Rule | Suggested | Owner | Kind |, at most ~60 rows, most important first, then a short bullet list of native names left for R50/R51. Be precise; no speculation. Include only verified findings.

Checked and found compliant, so not listed:

  • diff/advect already use interface_coefficients, propagation_matrix, sphere_cluster(_factor), lattice_expansion(_from_table), periodic_to_cw and wignerd.
  • bessel/angular in diff, advect, jax and torch take function=.
  • advect uses positions, destination_positions/source_positions and kz/kzs as the glossary specifies.
  • kind='outgoing' raises ValueError in _validation.check_kind.
  • The framework Wave uses singular= and framework plane_wave(direction, pol).
  • diff.smatrix_tr(modetype=) is allowed by the glossary.
  • jax's "custom-VJP" is JAX's own API term.
  • advect's Advect-primitive residual= parameter is Advect's own API term.

Native names left for R50a-c / R51 (python/treams_rs/_native.pyi, and diff/iterative call sites)

  • Context classes (R50a): QContext, MetricContext, SingularContext, ArrayContext, ChannelsContext (shared), SMatrixContext, PropagationContext, ClusterContext, ChiralityContext, EigenContext, IlluminationContext, InteractionIlluminationContext, BandContext, CylinderContext/CylinderMatrixContext, PeriodicContext, PeriodicTableContext, PeriodicConversionContext, PlanePhaseContext, InterfaceContext, LayersContext, WignerContext, CoordinateContext, VectorCoordinateContext, WaveContext, PolarTranslationContext, GammaContext, KambeContext, TransmissionContext.
    • The class NativeSphereCluster (becomes IterativeSphereCluster) is also still there.
    • The _native.XContext return annotations in diff.py follow automatically.
  • Functions (R50b/c):
    • Records and operations: cluster, cluster_factor, interact, linear_solve, interface, propagation, cyl_expansion, cyl_rotation, periodic_expansion, periodic_cyl_expansion, periodic_from_table, periodic_conversion, wigner/wigner_scalar, gamma_record(_scalar), kambe_record(_scalar), lattice_record, bessel/bessel_scalar, angular/angular_value, legendre_real_value, coordinates, vector_coordinates, vector_wave, spherical_translation, cylindrical_translation (no _record suffix yet).
    • Scalar fast paths: cylindrical_rotation_scalar, cylindrical_translate_scalar, cylindrical_translation_scalar, plane_permutation_scalar, direct_cylindrical_1d(_shift)/_2d, incgamma/intkambe scalars.
    • S-matrix: smatrix_transmittance, smatrix_illuminate_forward.
    • Test hooks: translation, spherical_wave, cyl_translation, cylindrical.
  • Parameters (R51):
    • outgoing (pyi 117, 125, 386, 436, 445, 475) → singular.
    • origins (113, 121, 431, 440, 538, 546) → positions.
    • to/to_positions (80, 128-137, 380-391, 470-496, 596-598, 946-948) → destination/destination_positions.
    • input_shapes (682) → argument_shapes.
    • kind selector in bessel/angular (239, 248, 262, 265, 271) → function.
    • legacy (85) → radial_area_factor.
    • bloch/vectors/shift (489-500, 932-934) → kpar/a/r.
    • transmission (977) → direction.
    • NativeSphereCluster.solve_with_pullback (56) → record.
  • R28: the pullback order of ClusterContext and IterativeContext is still (radii, positions, epsilon, k0[, incident, reports]).
